remarks: Beautifully renovated and impeccably maintained 1-bedroom apartment with garage parking for one car located in the heart of downtown Stamford. Walking distance to restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and transportation. Freshly and professionally painted, this bright and stylish unit offers comfortable living with tasteful modern updates throughout.  The updated kitchen features a newer range, refrigerator, cabinetry, countertops, and flooring, creating a clean and contemporary space. Spacious dining area with room for a large table. The neutral bathroom includes a brand-new vanity. Large bedroom with two closets and a new wall a/c unit. Spacious living room with access to a private balcony overlooking Summer Street - the perfect spot to enjoy city views or watch Stamford's seasonal parades and events.  Recently updated laundry room and a convenient on-site fitness room.  Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are included in the rent, offering exceptional value in a prime downtown location. Enjoy the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and chic city living in this secure and well-maintained building.  Excellent credit required. Absolutely no smoking and no pets. Tenant responsible for credit and background check through RentSpree. Professional photos to follow.
